verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document per-pull-request preview deployments or ephemeral environments for Cloudflare Workers. Related items only show adjacent capabilities: Git/GitHub Actions compatibility, version rollbacks, and a Workers Builds MCP server. None of these establishes the product creating full-stack preview environments for each PR.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request
